notes.title: 🌟New content and release of Soak & Splash!
notes.notes:
Soak & Splash received a big update and left early access!

List of changes :

⭕️New minigame Pickle Hunt!
https://iili.io/J0Vero7.png
⭕️New buckets to douse yourself!
https://iili.io/J0VkkqF.png
⭕️New warrior skin!
https://iili.io/J0V87M7.png
⭕️And of course bug fixes!

📀Thank you everyone for your attention and support! See you in new updates!

notes.title: Food and Christmas update!
notes.notes:
😍Thank you everyone for your support and waiting!

🎅🏼We are pleased to bring you the Christmas and Food update. Now you can save money and buy yourself food to become stronger and faster! 

🎁Don't forget to open your Christmas gifts, you deserve them!

🍅If your goal is not to win, but to relax with friends, you can get food without effects for free!

🍟Enjoy the game and report any bugs to us! Merry Christmas!

notes.title: Server list update!
notes.notes:
We have received many messages that you cannot find your friends' servers.
We found out that the problem was in sorting the servers by the number of players.

🔸We have fixed this and you will now see all servers, but they will not be sorted for now as we are still working on this issue.
